# Living Spaces Gardening
> Native landscaping, garden design, and habitat restoration serving residential and commercial clients in the Tampa Bay and St. Petersburg, Florida area using exclusively Florida native plants.
Living Spaces Gardening was founded in 2018 by Kiamesha Wray, a Florida Master Naturalist (since 2014) and one of the first FANN credentialed professionals in Florida. The company designs and installs native plant landscapes that support local ecosystems while creating beautiful, low-maintenance outdoor spaces for homes and businesses across Tampa Bay.
## Main Pages
- [Homepage](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/): Overview of native landscaping services for homes and businesses in Tampa Bay
- [About](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/#about): Kiamesha Wray's background, credentials, and the Living Spaces Gardening story
- [Services](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/#services): Full list of native landscaping and garden design services
- [For HOAs and Communities](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/for-hoa): Native landscaping conversion services for HOA communities, condo associations, and neighborhood boards in Tampa Bay
- [HOA Guide](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/hoa-guide): Free downloadable guide for HOA boards on converting community landscapes to Florida native plants
- [Press](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/press.html): Media coverage and features including Homes and Gardens magazine
- [Contact](https://www.livingspacesgardening.com/#contact): Get in touch or request a consultation
